description: scriptconv's own orthography2ipa backend (Phonemizer.ORTHOGRAPHY2IPA), a general-purpose rule-based grapheme->IPA mapper and scriptconv's own default fallback for languages with no other explicit LANG_DEFAULTS entry. get_ipa('hello','en-US')=='hɛlɒ', get_ipa('mundo','pt-PT')=='ˈmũdu' verified on 3 samples/lang.
notes: Verified working for en-US and pt-PT in the shared venv, no extra package required, on 3 samples/lang.
